author: Ananya Singhal
comment: Bansal Jewellers made our wedding jewellery memorable. The ninth-generation heritage really shows in the polki finishing. Every piece was BIS hallmarked and delivered right on schedule!

author: Vikramaditya Agarwal
comment: We have been sourcing 22K hallmarked gold and certified diamond sets from Bansal Jewellers for over 8 years. Consistent purity, zero discrepancy, and prompt logistics across our Mathura showrooms.

author: Pooja & Rohan Mittal
comment: Got our custom solitaire designed in 3D CAD first. The diamond brilliance and Surat atelier finish is superior to any big commercial chain in Delhi, with genuine IGI certification.

author: Meenakshi Bansal
comment: 200 years of trust is real. The weight transparency, karat-meter purity test in the showroom, and warm hospitality made this our family's permanent jewellery house.
